profile.legalName: California Department of Toxic Substances Control
profile.summary: The California Department of Toxic Substances Control (DTSC) is a California state agency within the California Environmental Protection Agency. It protects public health and the environment from hazardous waste by regulating how hazardous waste is handled and by cleaning up contaminated sites. It also runs grant programs such as the Equitable Community Revitalization Grant for cleanup in disadvantaged communities.

sources.title: California Department of Toxic Substances Control - Wikipedia

review.notes: The agenda item is a grant agreement with the CA Department of Toxic Substances Control for its Equitable Community Revitalization Grant, and the profile describes that state agency. Wikipedia confirms the name, CalEPA parent, Sacramento headquarters, mission and dtsc.ca.gov. The ECRG sentence is not on the cited page, but DTSC's own ECRG guidelines (found via search) confirm it is a DTSC grant program open to school districts.
